serviceSummary: Image generation service is not implemented. This loop is design-only. No OpenAI API call is allowed. No image generation is allowed. No image upload or storage is allowed. Authorized source evidence, product facts, commercial readiness and image QA are not approved yet. Do not create eBay draft. Do not publish. Human approval is required before any future dryRun or real generation.

allowedInThisLoop: Create read-only image generation service design fixture.
Render read-only Image Generation Service Design section in Admin.
Add tests for design, readiness, boundaries, image types, blocked workflows and safety flags.
forbiddenInThisLoop: Do not create a real image generation service.
Do not create an OpenAI client.
Do not use real product images.
Do not call Luna Portex APIs.
serviceBoundaries.imagePolicy: Future image generation must only use approved authorized source evidence and validated product facts. The main image must remain product-accurate and must not include text, badges, watermarks or unsupported claims.
serviceBoundaries.dryRunPolicy: Future dryRun must produce only structured plans and prompts for review until explicit human approval unlocks real generation.

blockedWorkflows.reason: OpenAI image generation is not allowed in this design-only loop.
Main image generation requires approved source evidence and human approval.
Secondary images require validated product facts and approved source evidence.
No image upload is allowed before storage strategy, QA and human approval.
No generated or enhanced image candidate exists for QA.
eBay image package mapping requires approved image QA.
Draft mapping requires approved images, product facts and commercial readiness.
No eBay draft can be created before approved images and human approval.
No eBay publication is allowed before final explicit human approval.

requiredHumanActions: Approve authorized Luna Portex image source evidence.
Validate product facts before any secondary image prompt exists.
Approve prompt policy for main image and secondary images.
Approve future dryRun-only image generation contract.
Approve future OpenAI implementation separately before any API call.
Approve image storage and upload strategy before storing image candidates.
Complete image QA before eBay image package mapping.
Keep eBay draft mapping, draft creation and publication blocked until all image gates are approved.
